terminology: Retrospective external validation. Curated reference drugs are literature-known DDR1 inhibitors selected by hand from the literature, not prospective blind compounds.
caveats: The screening model was trained without the curated drugs and, in exact_plus_scaffold mode, without their Murcko-scaffold analogs.
DrugBank is a ranking pool, not a decoy set. A high rank means the drug was prioritised above the other DrugBank compounds, not that it is a validated DDR1 inhibitor.
Ranks are relative to whatever compounds DrugBank happens to contain. They are not enrichment against a curated inactive control set.
With 4-6 drugs, report each rank individually. Do not aggregate into a 'top X%' claim as if it were a statistical result.
The predicted pIC50 is a computational estimate, not a measured potency. Vina and PLIP scores downstream are not Delta-G values.
